knowledgeAnswers.rationale: WorkSafe Victoria requires a current SDS for each hazardous product, accessible to workers who may be exposed.
The product goes on the hazards register before its first use.
WorkSafe Victoria states that aerosol hair colours must not be used on eyelashes or eyebrows.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks that the candidate can open the current SDS for a named kit product and read its control section
Assessor checks the hazards register entry for a named product against its SDS
evidenceRequired: Hazards register extract with identifier and SDS for each product
Dated SDS for the named product
stopWorkCriteria: A kit product is used with no current SDS on hand
A product is used for a purpose its SDS or named source rules out
